verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de markets "B2B bulk notarization", and its translation endpoint accepts one or multiple documents in a single request. That is first-party evidence of multi-item operations, but it is thin and limited to these two services. missing for 10: documented batch endpoints or bulk semantics for notarization, incorporation and registrations; limits and error handling for bulk jobs; bulk status/retrieval operations; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: B2B bulk notarization and API integration
This endpoint creates a translation request for one or multiple documents.
